description:
Stock your nursery with confidence using the French Country 6 Drawer Dresser from Old Time Oak. With six spacious dovetailed drawers, this dresser provides ample room for your growing child's wardrobe, from baby onesies through school-age favorites.
Each drawer features full-extension glides for easy access to items at the back, and the sturdy dovetail construction ensures lasting durability. The solid wood frame with French Country detailing, including turned legs and decorative hardware, brings timeless warmth to your nursery. The wide, flat top accommodates a changing pad for a complete diaper station during the early months.
Crafted from solid wood with non-toxic, baby-safe finishes, this dresser is built to last through every stage of childhood. The classic design transitions beautifully from nursery to big-kid room. Coordinates with the complete French Country collection of cribs, nightstands, and chests.
